assumptions.statement_zh: 本方案使用仓库提供的临时粗略边界数据，该数据基于公告文字四至和面积约束推算，不等同于官方红线。
assumptions.statement_en: This proposal uses repository-provided provisional rough boundary data, derived from announcement text and area constraints, not equivalent to official redlines.
assumptions.mitigation_zh: 待正式GIS/CAD数据发布后，所有面积指标和空间分析需重新复算。
assumptions.mitigation_en: When official GIS/CAD data becomes available, all area metrics and spatial analyses must be recalculated.

assumptions.statement_zh: 所有空间布局、建筑规模、用地功能均为概念建议，不构成正式规划审定结论。
assumptions.statement_en: All spatial layouts, building scales, and land-use functions are conceptual suggestions, not formal planning approvals.
assumptions.mitigation_zh: 方案明确标注为概念建议，供专业团队深化研究参考。
assumptions.mitigation_en: Proposal clearly labeled as conceptual suggestions for professional teams to deepen.

assumptions.statement_zh: 全球案例研究基于公开可获取的信息，部分数据可能非最新版本。
assumptions.statement_en: Global case studies are based on publicly available information; some data may not be the latest version.
assumptions.mitigation_zh: 案例数据用于概念对比和经验借鉴，不作为精确量化依据。
assumptions.mitigation_en: Case data used for conceptual comparison and lessons, not as precise quantitative basis.

assumptions.statement_zh: 远期指标（如AI企业1000+家、AI人才50000+人）为概念愿景，非政府承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: Long-term indicators (e.g., 1000+ AI enterprises, 50000+ AI talent) are conceptual visions, not government commitments.
assumptions.mitigation_zh: 方案明确标注所有远期指标为概念建议，非确定性承诺。
assumptions.mitigation_en: Proposal clearly labels all long-term indicators as conceptual, not committed.
